shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ---; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ---; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v '^./.agents' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---ROUTING; rg -n -i -C 3 'i18n|locale|lang' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo ---TRAPS; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ---UIKIT; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 305,330p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ---I18N-PKG; grep -E '"version"|"main"|"types"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/docs 2>/dev/null; echo ---I18N-README; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -200; echo ---ICONS; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -n 'gravity-ui/i18n\|gravity-ui/icons' package-lock.json | head; echo ---EVAL; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup Select Text Flex Card Button TextInput Switch Label 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---CONFIGURE; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name 'configure*.d.ts' | head; echo ---I18N-DTS; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup Select Text Flex Card Button TextInput Switch Label 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---CONFIGURE; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ---SRG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ---CARD; grep -n 'view\|theme\|type\|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; echo ---FLEX; grep -n 'direction\|gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|wrap' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -20; echo ---BOX; grep -n 'spacing\|as' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head; echo ---TEXT; grep -n 'variant\|color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -20; echo ---README-SETUP; rg -n -i -C 3 'configure|lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; echo ---I18N-UIKIT; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/i18n* node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js

echo ---INDEX; grep -n 'configure\|i18n\|Lang\|SegmentedRadioGroup\|layout\|Pagination\|Alert\|Card\|Text\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ---CGP; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | grep -n -A 12 'interface ControlGroupProps\|interface ControlGroupOption'; echo ---KEYSETS; ls -d node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/i18n | xargs -n1 dirname | xargs -n1 basename | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---PAG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; grep -n 'page\|total\|size\|onUpdate\|compact\|showInput\|showPages' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---TEXTINPUT; grep -n 'label\|placeholder\|hasClear\|note\|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---ALERT; grep -n 'theme\|title\|message\|onClose\|view' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts | head -12; echo ---I18N-TYPES; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -40
